job.title: [Post] URGENT HIRING | SALESFORCE COMMERCE CLOUD (SFCC) – SENIOR API DEVELOPER Vitim Cloud Techno…

tailoring.headline: Senior API Developer | Java, Spring & REST APIs | E-Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot and RESTful/OCC APIs, building microservices and integrating PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Proven record of designing data pipelines, optimizing SQL performance, and executing CI/CD deployments on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2). Strong techno-functional consulting experience, gathering requirements, writing user stories and supporting production for international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior API Developer – Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Vitim Cloud Technologies’ focus on scaling Salesforce Commerce Cloud APIs, a challenge that aligns perfectly with my five-plus years of designing, building and optimizing high-performance e-commerce APIs on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell.

bullets.label: **API Development**
bullets.text: Delivered robust OCC REST Web Services and custom API migrations at Rockwell, handling high-volume storefront and third-party integrations.

bullets.label: **Integration Engineering**
bullets.text: Designed end-to-end PIM-to-Commerce data pipelines and resolved ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks, ensuring data consistency across global channels.

bullets.label: **Performance & Scalability**
bullets.text: Refactored complex FlexibleSearch queries and optimized SQL performance, reducing response latency and supporting large transaction volumes.

bullets.label: **Techno-Functional Leadership**
bullets.text: Collaborated with international business stakeholders to translate requirements into user stories, functional specs and production support processes.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute.

tailoring.why_company: Vitim Cloud Technologies stands out for its rapid growth in delivering Salesforce Commerce Cloud solutions that enable brands to create seamless, API-driven shopping experiences. I am drawn to your commitment to innovation and to scaling complex integrations, which matches my passion for building high-performance e-commerce APIs. Joining a team that pushes the limits of SFCC aligns with my goal to apply my SAP Commerce expertise to accelerate your customers’ digital transformation.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my proven API and integration expertise to help Vitim Cloud accelerate SFCC projects, delivering reliable, scalable commerce solutions for your clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior Java/SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of API and integration experience. I’m eager to bring my expertise to Vitim Cloud’s SFCC team. Open to discuss?
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your SFCC API layer by applying proven OCC-style design patterns, streamline PIM-ERP data flows, and enhance CI/CD pipelines for faster releases. My background in high-volume e-commerce platforms ensures reliable performance and rapid delivery.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Senior API Developer (SFCC) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am Kranti Chavan, a senior backend developer with over five years of experience building and scaling e-commerce APIs on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Vitim Cloud’s focus on expanding Salesforce Commerce Cloud capabilities excites me, and I can immediately contribute by designing robust API integrations, optimizing data pipelines, and strengthening CI/CD processes. I have identified the need for efficient API migration strategies in your posting and can address it from day one. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
